summary: Single-line text field with optional prefix and suffix. Give it a label prop for a complete field, or place it inside a Field.
whenToUse: Short free text: a name, a URL, a search query, a value with a unit.
prefix for an icon or a currency, suffix for a unit or a keyboard hint.
size follows density: sm in toolbars and filters, md in forms, lg only on sparse screens.
whenNotToUse: More than one line: use Textarea.
Numbers with steps, min and max: use NumberField (increment buttons, arrow keys, locale formatting).
Choosing from a known list: Select for under about ten options, Combobox for long or searchable lists.

dos.title: Label above, format help in the hint
dos.text: The label stays visible while typing; the hint answers the question before it is asked.

dos.title: Units in the suffix
dos.text: The value stays a number the user can edit; the unit is context, not content.

donts.title: Clearing the value on error
donts.text: Keep what the user typed and say how to fix it.

accessibility: Base UI Input: inherits label, description and error wiring from the surrounding Field.
The field edge (color.border.strong) has at least 3:1 contrast with the surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).
Focus shows a 2px signal-colored edge on every focus, since users type into it.
On touch screens the text is 17px so iOS does not zoom the page on focus.
A prefix icon is decorative; if the prefix carries meaning (a currency), make it text.
contentGuidelines: Placeholders show an example value, not instructions: "color.action.primary.bg", not "Enter a token name".
Errors name the problem and the fix, in one or two short sentences.

anatomy.control: Bordered box (holds prefix, input and suffix)
